content:
The image shows a corn leaf sheath/stalk area with:
- Dark purple to brown discoloration covering large areas of the tissue
- Small dark/black specks scattered across the surface
- Tan to brown background coloration with purple streaking
- Lesions on what appears to be the leaf collar/sheath region

The purple-to-brown coloration on the stalk/leaf collar, with scattered dark lesions and the random distribution pattern, aligns strongly with **Purple_Leaf_Sheath**. The symptom description mentions "dark lesions on corn stalks and leaf collars, with color varying from purple to brown to black" and scattered random distribution — which matches this image well.

The small black specks could also suggest Tar Spot (black glossy stromata), but the dominant feature here is the widespread purple-brown discoloration of the sheath tissue, not discrete raised black spots. Physoderma Brown Spot can show purplish spots on midrib/sheath but the pattern here is more diffuse purple staining rather than distinct oval spots.
